subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should CodexBar adopt a permanent top-level Usage & Spend Settings pane, or integrate this aggregation into the existing shared Overview/provider-driven UI?
rationale: Both placements are technically plausible, but VISION.md requires sign-off for new features and favors shared provider-driven UI over one-off surfaces.

options.title: Integrate with shared Overview
options.body: Keep the aggregation model but move its presentation into the established shared overview pattern to limit permanent navigation and maintenance surface.

options.title: Approve the dedicated pane
options.body: Accept a new top-level Settings destination because the wider spend-first comparisons are considered a core product surface.

options.title: Pause the dashboard
options.body: Defer or close the feature if the added analytics and multi-home scanning complexity are not worth carrying in the application.

recommendation.title: Integrate with shared Overview
recommendation.body: Keep the aggregation model but move its presentation into the established shared overview pattern to limit permanent navigation and maintenance surface.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the strongest available owner for the explicit VISION.md product-surface decision.
